correctness.rationale: For every nonempty X with identical first/last symbol a and no adjacent aa, and fresh z∉X, T=XzXXzX^- contains exactly two z's. The maximal aligned repeated factor containing z is B=XzX^- at starts 0 and 2m+1; each z-free run X, XX, X^- contains complete X copies only at 0,m+1,2m+1 because the join XX uniquely creates aa. The middle X has unique left/right extensions, hence a net occurrence; proper factors of these three marked repeated occurrences have at least one repeated one-symbol extension and cannot be net. Any repeated factor containing z aligns the two z's and is contained in a B; any repeated z-free factor either cannot cross unique aa or is contained in a complete X. Thus exactly (0,2m),(m+1,m),(2m+1,2m) net position-length pairs. The Zimin recursion Z_{j+1}=Z_j j Z_j, no '00', gives W_d=Z_d, W_{d+1}=Z_{d-1}(d−1)Z_{d-1}Z_{d-1}(d−1)Z_{d-1}^-, and earlier iterates have exactly two repeated maximal Z-block occurrences. Reconstructed this induction; independent all-factor extension enumeration checked 379 admissible marked words, corroboration not infinite proof. k=0,1 zero, 2≤k≤d two, k=d+1 three (d≥3). No assertion for higher k.
